matches.rationale: No finding addresses the inflated benchmark success rates (nearly 5% on R2R-CE, over 13% on REVERIE-CE) in Section 4.1, Tables 1 and 2. Finding 1 concerns a different section (4.6, Table 7) and a different issue (missing feature dropout rows), while Finding 2 addresses a citation error in Section 3.2.

No finding addresses the logical inconsistency between the Merging Discriminator and Frustum Culling strategy in Section 3.1. Neither Finding 1 (Section 4.6 noise robustness) nor Finding 2 (Section 3.2 citation misattribution) targets this method-logic flaw.

No finding addresses the exaggerated novelty claims in the Introduction that understate existing approaches. Both findings are located in entirely different sections (4.6 and 3.2) and concern unrelated issues.

No finding addresses the omission of environment familiarity controls in the pre-exploration and lifelong memory experiments. Neither finding discusses Section 4.2 experimental design or potential data leakage.
No finding addresses the missing ethical approvals, consent, or safety protocols for real-world robot experiments in Section 4.3. Neither finding touches on ethical integrity concerns.
No finding addresses the inflated language in the Abstract claiming 'new state-of-the-art performance.' Both findings are in different sections and concern different types of errors.
No finding addresses the misleading reference narrative in the Related Work section that exaggerates uniqueness. Neither finding discusses Section 2 or the treatment of prior work.

No finding addresses the overreaching claims in the Conclusion that contradict cautious experimental results. Neither finding targets Section 5 or the cross-section inconsistency between the conclusion and experimental sections.

While Finding 1 is located in the same section (4.6, Table 7), it identifies a different issue: text claiming feature dropout and spatial jitter ablations that are absent from Table 7. GT 9 concerns the incompleteness of the actual SLAM/depth noise experiments in exploring 3D representation degradation, not a text-table inconsistency about missing experimental rows. These are distinct scientific issues.
No finding addresses the missing ethical use, consent, or data privacy statements in the Appendix (Section A.1). Neither finding discusses ethical omissions in dataset and training descriptions.

No finding addresses the unsubstantiated claim about balancing real-time adaptability with long-term memory without quantitative metrics on memory saturation or update latency. Neither finding targets this overstatement.

No finding addresses the strong definitive language in the Introduction's contribution summary (e.g., 'achieves state-of-the-art performance') that ignores caveats. Neither finding discusses rhetorical manipulation in the Introduction.
